lines.text: Most wellness programmes are built for an average employee.
But nobody has an average day.
Sleep, workload, meetings, pressure. It all shows up at work.
Meet Glyth Workplace.
Glyth gives every employee a personal wellbeing companion that understands their day, and plans around what matters.
This morning, you're on track. Strength training at seven, deep work at ten, and the investor meeting at two.
Then life happens.
Four hours and forty-two minutes of sleep. Your third short night in a row.
Most apps would just show you a score. Glyth re-plans your workday.
Heavy training becomes a recovery session.
Deep work is protected.
A recovery break is added before your meeting.
Admin moves to tomorrow. And the meeting that matters never moves.
Tap why, and Glyth shows its reasoning: what it observed, and how it responded.
You stay in control. Ask Glyth anything, and nothing changes until you confirm it.
And your personal data stays yours. Your employer never sees your sleep, your health, or your conversations.
Because wellbeing at work is about more than sleep.
Training that adapts to how you've recovered.
A five-minute reset before a high-pressure meeting.
Gentle nudges to stay connected with the people who matter.
And clarity on your finances, because money worries come to work too.
One companion for the whole person.
For employers, Glyth Workplace turns wellbeing into something you can see, and act on.
A live view of how your organisation is doing. Team by team, in aggregate.
Glyth spots patterns early, like meeting load starting to eat into focus time.
It suggests a response. You approve it. Then you see what changed.
Focus fragmentation in one team, down from thirty-one to twenty-one percent.
Run programmes across teams, and measure their impact over time.
All without surveillance. Small teams stay private, and individual data is never shown.
Healthier people. Better work.
Glyth Workplace.
Wellbeing that works with your workday.
